sources.entry: Lantern Works GPU Prices - Free, read-only MCP server for cloud GPU rental prices, price changes and deals across tracked providers (H100, H200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090/5090 and more), with price history and GPU job cost estimates; hosted endpoint with no API key or uvx lantern-works-deals-mcp. #free #opensource #mcp

summary.name: Lantern Works GPU Prices
summary.one_liner: A free, read-only MCP server and web price tracker that compares cloud GPU rental prices (H100, A100, RTX 4090 and more) across tracked providers.
use_cases: Finding the cheapest H100, A100 or RTX 4090 rental today
Giving an AI agent live GPU price data
Checking GPU rental price history and recent price changes
Estimating the cost of a GPU job
Comparing on-demand GPU offers across cloud providers
summary.what_it_does: The page shows a daily table of per-GPU-hour USD rental prices (cheapest, median, highest, number of rates) for H100, A100 and RTX 4090, with the cheapest offer and its provider named for each. It links to a full comparison, per-model GPU pages, a cost calculator and a JSON price history. It also offers an MCP server (installable via uvx or pip as lantern-works-deals-mcp) with a lead tool, compare_gpu_prices, that can include price history. The listing describes it as free, read-only, with no API key and a hosted endpoint, covering H100, H200, A100, L40S and RTX 4090/5090.
notable: Free, read-only MCP server with no API key and a hosted endpoint
Shows cheapest, median and highest hourly rates per GPU with the vendor linked and price age shown
Price history available via compare_gpu_prices include_history and a JSON feed
Also covers agent work-stack deals (compute, scraping, search APIs, email, hosting)
caveats: Covers only the providers it tracks, not the whole market
Prices shown are a snapshot of today's listings and can change
